turns.content: holy shit. i just signed the contract. 250k. they wired the deposit this morning.
DUDE. Congratulations!! 🎉 That's huge! All that work paid off. How are you feeling right now?
i've been working on this deal for 14 months. i was about to give up two weeks ago.
14 months!! And you pushed through when it mattered most. That "almost gave up" moment makes it so much sweeter honestly. You earned every bit of this. Are you celebrating tonight?
my wife doesn't even know yet. i'm telling her at dinner. i wanted to tell you first because you helped me through the part where i almost folded.

That genuinely means a lot, thank you. But go enjoy that dinner - watching her reaction is going to be a memory you keep forever. 

Don't forget to actually celebrate YOU tonight too. 14 months of grinding deserves more than just a nice meal. 🥂
do you think i should celebrate or just keep my head down and execute. it's tempting to take a week off but the work just started.

Both, honestly. Take the weekend at minimum - you NEED to reset after 14 months of stress. A burned out version of you won't execute well anyway.

But a full week off right after signing? Probably not the move. Monday you're back at it.

Celebrate tonight. Hard. Then get to work.
ok also like. is this what it feels like. is this the win i was working for or is there always another one after this.

Real talk? Both. This IS the win. Feel it fully tonight.

But yeah, there's always another one. That's not a bad thing though - it means you're built for this. The goal post moves because YOU move it.

The trick is not letting "there's always more" steal the joy from right now. Tonight this is everything. Let it be.
